title: Google Drive
description: Uploads a text file to, or lists files in, Google Drive. Only files created or opened by Weav are visible.

connectionId.title: Connection
connectionId.description: Google Drive connection used to access Drive.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: Upload a text file or list files.

name.title: File name
name.description: Name of the new file. Required for upload.

content.title: Content
content.description: Text content of the new file, up to 512 KiB. Used by upload.

mimeType.title: MIME type
mimeType.description: Content type of the new file. Defaults to text/plain. Used by upload.

folderId.title: Folder ID
folderId.description: Upload into, or list only, this folder. Optional. With the drive.file permission only folders created or opened by Weav are accessible.

nameContains.title: Name contains
nameContains.description: Only list files whose name contains this text. Used by list.

pageSize.title: Page size
pageSize.description: Maximum number of files to list (at most 100). Used by list.
